speed.description: Vehicle speed in 0.1 km/h increments. Valid range: `0` to `2200` (0 km/h to 220 km/h). Special values: `0xFF,0xFE` = Abnormal; `0xFF,0xFF` = Invalid data

mileage.description: Total vehicle mileage in 0.1 km increments. Valid range: `0` to `9999999` (0 km to 999999.9 km). Special values: `0xFF,0xFF,0xFF,0xFE` = Abnormal; `0xFF,0xFF,0xFF,0xFF` = Invalid data

soc.description: State of Charge (SOC) of the vehicle battery in 0.5% increments. Valid range: `0` to `100` (0% to 100%)

dc_dc_sts.description: DC-DC converter status: `1` = Working; `2` = Disconnected; `254` = Abnormal state; `255` = Invalid data

gear.description:
Gear position encoded as a byte with bit-level definitions:
bit7: Reserved (set to `0`); bit6: Reserved (set to `0`)
bit5: Accelerator pedal press (`1` = Valid press, `0` = Invalid/no press)
bit4: Brake pedal press (`1` = Valid press, `0` = Invalid/no press)
bit3-bit0: Gear code: `0x0` = Neutral; `0x1`-`0x6` = 1st-6th gear; `0x7`-`0xC` = Reserved; `0xD` = Reverse; `0xE` = Drive; `0xF` = Parking

urgt_prw_shtdwn.description: Urgent pre-shutdown (crash detection) status: `0` = No crash detected; `1` = Crash detected

comf_ena.description: Comfort mode enablement status: Valid values are `VehicleStatus_ComfortType_COMFORT_ENABLE` or `VehicleStatus_ComfortType_COMFORT_DISABLE`

thermal_keeping.description: Thermal management status: `true` = Thermal keeping active; `false` = Thermal keeping exited

ntester.description: nTester plugin status: `true` = Shutdown initiated; `false` = No shutdown

valid.description:
Validity of the brake pedal status data. Valid values:
`0` = BRK_PED_VALID
`1` = BRK_PED_INVALID

state.description:
Brake pedal pressed state. Valid values:
`0` = NOT_PRESSED
`1` = PRESSED
`2` = RESERVED
`3` = ERROR

vcu_drvg_mod.description:
Driving mode selected via the Vehicle Control Unit (VCU). Valid values:
`0` = Automatic mode
`1` = Economy mode
`2` = Comfort mode
`3` = Sport mode
`4` = Snow mode
`5` = EP mode
`6-7` = Reserved

steer_whl_rotn_ag.description: Steering wheel rotation angle relative to center. Valid range: -80° to +80° (degrees)

steer_whl_rotn_spd.description: Steering wheel rotation speed. Valid range: -12750°/s to +12750°/s (degrees per second)

aclrtn_pedal_posn.description: Accelerator pedal position percentage. Valid range: 0-100 (represents 0%-100% with 1% increments). Special values: `0xFE` = Malfunction; `0xFF` = Invalid data

average_speed.description: Average vehicle speed over the last reporting interval. Valid range: 0-360 km/h

max_speed.description: Maximum vehicle speed recorded during the last reporting interval. Valid range: 0-360 km/h

min_speed.description: Minimum vehicle speed recorded during the last reporting interval. Valid range: 0-360 km/h

DrivingData.description: Real-time driving behavior and vehicle control data captured during the last reporting interval

door_ajar_re_ri_sts.description:
Rear right door ajar status (enum AjarStatus):

door_lock_frnt_le_sts.description:

door_lock_frnt_ri_sts.description:
Front right door lock status (enum LockStatus):

entry_meth.description:

`0` = Remote app, `1` = Key fob 1, `2` = Key fob 2, `3` = NFC, `4` = Reserved, `7` = Invalid data
